latin: Organum odoratus sunt caruncule mamillares in anteriori cerebri parte constitutae.
translation: The organ of smell is the mammillary caruncles situated in the anterior part of the brain.
translation_note: 'Caruncule mamillares' (mammillary caruncles/processes) is the medieval anatomical term, following Avicenna, for what later anatomy identifies with the olfactory bulbs (farmer1998:13680).
